newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi stocks edge lower in subdued trade.
newsitem.headline: Saudi stocks edge lower in subdued trade.

text.p: Shares on Saudi Arabia's stock market ended last week lower in subdued trade focused on bank shares, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Sunday.
The all-share index closed 0.56 percent lower at 158.32 points from 159.21 points a week earlier.
BFA said traded volume was minimal at 361 million riyals, down by about 54 percent from the previous week. It attributed low trade to the holiday season.

Banking sector shares accounted for about 44 percent of trading value followed by services sector shares which accounted for 27 percent. Agriculture and electricity shares registered poor performances, accounting for one percent each.
Of the 55 shares traded in the week, nine rose, 30 fell and 16 were unchanged.
Saudi Real Estate Company led the week's gainers climbing 7.9 percent to 136 riyals from 126 riyals the previous week.
Hayel Agricultural Development and Yanbu Cement Co gained three percent each to 66 riyals and 238 riyals respectively.
Amiantit closed at 110 riyals down 8.3 percent from the previous week's 120 riyals, and Makkah Real Estate and Development ended the week at 251 riyals from 261 riyals.
